Phys = {alt = 0} function physconvert() local x,y,z,ax,ay,az = gN(4),gN(5),gN(6),gN(10),gN(11),gN(12) cx,sx,cy,sy,cz,sz = cos(x),sin(x),cos(y),sin(y),cos(z),sin(z) local m00,m01,m02,m10,m11,m12,m20,m21,m22=cy*cz,-cx*sz+sx*sy*cz,sx*sz+cx*sy*cz,cy*sz,cx*cz+sx*sy*sz,-sx*cz+cx*sy*sz,-sy,sx*cy,cx*cy
Phys.tiltX = gN(16) --m.atan(m10, m.sqrt(m00*m00 + m20*m20)) / pi2 Phys.tiltY = atan(m11, m.sqrt(m01*m01 + m21*m21)) / pi2 Phys.tiltZ = gN(15)-- m.atan(m12, m.sqrt(m02*m02 + m22*m22)) / pi2
Phys.angspX = m00*ax + m10*ay + m20*az Phys.angspY = m01*ax + m11*ay + m21*az Phys.angspZ = m02*ax + m12*ay + m22*az
local old_alt = Phys.alt Phys.alt = gN(2) Phys.v_speed = (alt-old_alt)*60 end function unpackBools(d,b)local f=S.unpack("I4",S.pack("f",d))for i=1,32 do b[i]=(f&(1<<(i-1)))~=0 end end function clamp(X,MIN,MAX)return min(max(X,MIN),MAX)end function lerp(MIN,MAX,X)return (1-X)*MIN+X*MAX end function sgn(X)return X < 0 and -1 or 1 end
